title: NavIC and GAGAN
quote: GAGAN augments GPS; NavIC is an independent regional system

boxes.title: NavIC basics
items: Genesis: US denied GPS in **1999 Kargil War**
**11** navigation satellites launched since **2013**, all from **Sriharikota**

items.what: **IRNSS-1F** last clock failed → only **3** PNT satellites (need **4**)

boxes.title: Applications
items: Precise timing for **Indian Standard Time**, power, banking
**IRNSS-1A** sends cyclone, tsunami alerts to fishermen

boxes.title: GAGAN
items: By **ISRO + AAI**; SBAS: corrects orbit, clock, ionospheric delay
Serves Indian **Flight Information Region**; DGCA certified **2015**

boxes.title: NavIC limitations
head: Limitation
Effect
rows: L5/S not in common phone chips
